backend_locks.schema:
CREATE TABLE `backend_locks` (
  `name` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

backend_migrations.schema:
CREATE TABLE `backend_migrations` (
  `name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `checksum` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `applied_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

ciudad.schema:
CREATE TABLE `ciudad` (
  `id_ciudad` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_ciudad`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

dias.schema:
CREATE TABLE `dias` (
  `id_dias` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `fecha` date NOT NULL,
  `fotos` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `descartes` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `venta_total` decimal(26,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `id_puesto` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_dias`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_dias_puesto_fecha` (`id_puesto`,`fecha`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_dias_id_puesto` (`id_dias`,`id_puesto`),
  KEY `ix_dias_fecha` (`fecha`,`id_puesto`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dias_puesto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_puesto`) REFERENCES `puesto` (`id_puesto`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_dias_descartes` CHECK ((`descartes` <= `fotos`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_dias_venta_total` CHECK ((`venta_total` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

evento.schema:
CREATE TABLE `evento` (
  `id_evento` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_evento`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

fotos.schema:
CREATE TABLE `fotos` (
  `id_fotos` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_archivo` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `id_dia` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_cliente` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `id_puesto` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_fotos`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_fotos_archivo` (`id_archivo`),
  KEY `fk_fotos_dia_puesto` (`id_dia`,`id_puesto`),
  KEY `ix_fotos_cliente` (`id_cliente`,`id_fotos`),
  KEY `ix_fotos_puesto_cliente` (`id_puesto`,`id_cliente`,`id_fotos`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fotos_cliente_optional` FOREIGN KEY (`id_cliente`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id_usuario`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fotos_dia_puesto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_dia`, `id_puesto`) REFERENCES `dias` (`id_dias`, `id_puesto`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fotos_puesto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_puesto`) REFERENCES `puesto` (`id_puesto`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_fotos_archivo` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`id_archivo`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

fotos_venta.schema:
CREATE TABLE `fotos_venta` (
  `id_fotos_venta` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_foto` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_venta` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_fotos_venta`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_fotos_venta` (`id_foto`,`id_venta`),
  KEY `fk_fotos_venta_venta` (`id_venta`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fotos_venta_foto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_foto`) REFERENCES `fotos` (`id_fotos`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fotos_venta_venta` FOREIGN KEY (`id_venta`) REFERENCES `venta` (`id_venta`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

horarios.schema:
CREATE TABLE `horarios` (
  `id_horario` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_dias` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_usuario` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `check_in` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `check_out` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_horario`),
  KEY `fk_horarios_dia` (`id_dias`),
  KEY `ix_horarios_usuario_fecha` (`id_usuario`,`check_in`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_horarios_dia` FOREIGN KEY (`id_dias`) REFERENCES `dias` (`id_dias`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_horarios_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`id_usuario`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id_usuario`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_horarios_orden` CHECK (((`check_out` is null) or (`check_out` >= `check_in`)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

permisos.schema:
CREATE TABLE `permisos` (
  `id_permisos` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tipo_de_permiso` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_permisos`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_permisos_tipo` (`tipo_de_permiso`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=41 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

permisos_rol.schema:
CREATE TABLE `permisos_rol` (
  `id_permisos_rol` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_permiso` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_rol` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_permisos_rol`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_permisos_rol` (`id_permiso`,`id_rol`),
  KEY `fk_permisos_rol_rol` (`id_rol`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_permisos_rol_permiso` FOREIGN KEY (`id_permiso`) REFERENCES `permisos` (`id_permisos`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_permisos_rol_rol` FOREIGN KEY (`id_rol`) REFERENCES `rol` (`id_rol`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=40 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

photo_uploads.schema:
CREATE TABLE `photo_uploads` (
  `operation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `id_actor` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_puesto` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `request_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `content_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `bucket` varchar(63) NOT NULL,
  `id_archivo` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `id_foto` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `last_attempt_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `cleaned_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `id_archivo` (`id_archivo`),
  UNIQUE KEY `id_foto` (`id_foto`),
  KEY `fk_upload_actor` (`id_actor`),
  KEY `fk_upload_puesto` (`id_puesto`),
  KEY `ix_upload_pending` (`id_foto`,`cleaned_at`,`last_attempt_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_upload_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`id_actor`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id_usuario`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_upload_foto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_foto`) REFERENCES `fotos` (`id_fotos`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_upload_puesto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_puesto`) REFERENCES `puesto` (`id_puesto`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

precios.schema:
CREATE TABLE `precios` (
  `id_precios` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `monto` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_precios`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_precios_monto` CHECK ((`monto` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

precios_venta.schema:
CREATE TABLE `precios_venta` (
  `id_precio_venta` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_venta` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_precio` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `precio_unitario_aplicado` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `cantidad` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_precio_venta`),
  KEY `fk_precios_venta_venta` (`id_venta`),
  KEY `fk_precios_venta_precio` (`id_precio`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_precios_venta_precio` FOREIGN KEY (`id_precio`) REFERENCES `precios` (`id_precios`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_precios_venta_venta` FOREIGN KEY (`id_venta`) REFERENCES `venta` (`id_venta`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_precios_venta_cantidad` CHECK ((`cantidad` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_precios_venta_precio` CHECK ((`precio_unitario_aplicado` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

puesto.schema:
CREATE TABLE `puesto` (
  `id_puesto` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `direccion` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `id_ciudad` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_evento` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_puesto`),
  KEY `fk_puesto_ciudad` (`id_ciudad`),
  KEY `fk_puesto_evento` (`id_evento`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_puesto_ciudad` FOREIGN KEY (`id_ciudad`) REFERENCES `ciudad` (`id_ciudad`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_puesto_evento` FOREIGN KEY (`id_evento`) REFERENCES `evento` (`id_evento`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

rol.schema:
CREATE TABLE `rol` (
  `id_rol` smallint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_rol`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_rol_nombre` (`nombre`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

sesiones_usuario.schema:
CREATE TABLE `sesiones_usuario` (
  `id_sesiones_usuario` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_usuario` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `last_seen_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_sesiones_usuario`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_sesiones_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `ix_sesiones_usuario_estado` (`id_usuario`,`revoked_at`,`expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_sesiones_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`id_usuario`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id_usuario`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_sesiones_actividad` CHECK (((`last_seen_at` is null) or (`last_seen_at` >= `created_at`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_sesiones_expiracion` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_sesiones_revocacion` CHECK (((`revoked_at` is null) or (`revoked_at` >= `created_at`)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tokens_autenticacion.schema:
CREATE TABLE `tokens_autenticacion` (
  `id_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `id_usuario` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tipo` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `used_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_tokens`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tokens_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `fk_tokens_usuario` (`id_usuario`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tokens_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`id_usuario`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id_usuario`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_tokens_expiracion` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_tokens_uso` CHECK (((`used_at` is null) or (`used_at` >= `created_at`)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

usuarios.schema:
CREATE TABLE `usuarios` (
  `id_usuario` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `apellido` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `dni` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `id_rol` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `id_puesto` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `disponible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `email_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `dni_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_usuario`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_usuarios_email_hash` (`email_hash`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_usuarios_dni_hash` (`dni_hash`),
  KEY `fk_usuarios_rol` (`id_rol`),
  KEY `ix_usuarios_puesto` (`id_puesto`,`disponible`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_usuarios_puesto` FOREIGN KEY (`id_puesto`) REFERENCES `puesto` (`id_puesto`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_usuarios_rol` FOREIGN KEY (`id_rol`) REFERENCES `rol` (`id_rol`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_usuarios_disponible` CHECK ((`disponible` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

venta.schema:
CREATE TABLE `venta` (
  `id_venta` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `cantidad` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `precio_total` decimal(26,2) NOT NULL,
  `id_dias` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_venta`),
  KEY `fk_venta_dia` (`id_dias`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_venta_dia` FOREIGN KEY (`id_dias`) REFERENCES `dias` (`id_dias`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_venta_cantidad` CHECK ((`cantidad` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_venta_precio_total` CHECK ((`precio_total` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
